messages.subject: how do I get rid of a double legend in ggmap?
parts:
Hi,

I’ve just started using ggmap. In my aes I have two variables that define the color and size of my ggplot, so I get two legends. However, I’d like to get rid of the one providing the size of my points, but I am not so sure on how to do this.

Any suggestion?

Ale

gmap <- get_map(location=c(34.2,29.4,36,33.5),zoom=7,source=“stamen”,maptype="toner")
ggmap(gmap)+
geom_point(aes(x=lon,y=lat,color=type,size=num),data=df)+
scale_colour_discrete(name ="Species",
labels=c("Alpha", "Beta","Delta","Gamma"),
breaks=c("alpha", "beta","delta","gamma"))+
scale_size_continuous(name ="Species",
labels=c("Alpha", "Beta","Delta","Gamma"),
breaks=c("alpha", "beta","delta","gamma"))+

messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Re: how do I get rid of a double legend in ggmap?
parts:
Like so?

qmplot(lon, lat, data = df, maptype = "toner", 
    color = type, size = num) +
  scale_colour_discrete("Species",
    labels = c("Alpha", "Beta","Delta","Gamma"),
    breaks = c("alpha", "beta","delta","gamma")
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous("Species",
    labels = c("Alpha", "Beta","Delta","Gamma"),
    breaks = c("alpha", "beta","delta","gamma"), 
    guide = FALSE
  )


Best
david.
